note: Monaco, though outside the EU and not a Schengen signatory, is administered as part of the Schengen Area through France (Convention of 1963): a visitor meets the EU's common list (the eu1806 list). Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Government's own page (a Common Crawl capture), which calls Monaco a gateway of the Schengen Area; the 1963 convention wasn't reached.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Schengen Area: territories and European microstates
sources.said: Although Monaco is not an official member of the European Union or a formal signatory to the Schengen Agreement, its territory is administered as an integral part of the Schengen Area.

sources.title: Gouvernement Princier de Monaco, Entretenir les relations avec l’Union européenne — Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-43 capture of 2026-10-07
sources.said: Seul Etat tiers à être intégré au territoire douanier européen, porte d’entrée de l’Espace Schengen et membre de la zone euro, la Principauté de Monaco entretient des liens multiples avec l’Union européenne.
